desc: discover and provide canonical access to local redfish bmc services
r: redfish-finder - discover and provide canonical access to local redfish bmc services

redfish-finder automatically discovers redfish based BMC services on a system, configures the appropriate network interface to access it, and adds a host entry to reach the service via the BMC configured name, and the canonical name 'redfish-localhost'

-h | --help
Display Usage synopsis and options description
-s | --shutdown
Remove OS Host and Interface configuration

/etc/hosts
redfish-finder will read and write /etc/hosts to add the redfish-localhost name
